headlines.title: New moment of silence held for those lost to 9/11 health effects
headlines.description: A moment of silence was held near ground zero in honor of those who have been impacted by the health-related effects of the aftermath of the 9/11 terror attacks in New York.

headlines.title: 25 years ago, Tom Brokaw anchors 9/11 NBC News Special Report
headlines.description: 25 years ago, Tom Brokaw delivered an NBC News Special Report on September 11, 2001, after terrorists hijacked four commercial planes and carried out coordinated attacks against targets in the U.S. Two were flown into the World Trade Center's Twin Towers, one into the Pentagon, and one – after the passengers and crew fought back – crashed into a field in Shanksville, Pennsylvania, killing nearly 3,000 people.

headlines.title: ‘Never Forget’: How Americans remember Sept. 11
headlines.description: From an 11-year-old watching the towers fall on a classroom TV to a doctor treating victims in a conference room, NBC News readers share their searing memories from Sept. 11, 2001.

headlines.title: FBI agent died of cancer after 9/11 Pentagon response. His widow tells his story.
headlines.description: An FBI agent who responded to the Pentagon on 9/11 later died from cancer. His wife is telling their story.

headlines.title: Lutnick says Trump’s $5,000 checks for Americans wouldn’t rely on taxpayer funds
headlines.description: President Donald Trump’s promised $5,000 “dividend” for all U.S. adults would not be paid for with taxpayer dollars, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said.

headlines.title: CIA officer charged in gold bars case working toward a plea deal
headlines.description: A former CIA officer who was arrested this spring with more than 303 gold bars worth $40 million in his home is working to finalize a plea deal with federal prosecutors that could help keep the case shrouded in mystery.

headlines.title: More AI researchers warn of AI's threat to humanity
headlines.description: NBC News' Tom Llamas spoke to two more artificial intelligence researchers about the potential threat A.I has to humanity. This comes after AI researcher Jacob Coxon shared a viral tweet saying he believed AI could kill humanity in the next decade. Llamas also spoke to Incoming Professor at UC Berkley Sayash Kapoor who also warns of risk, but says policy proposals and regulations can help prevent further threats.

headlines.title: 49ers easily defeat ‘withered’ Rams in battle of competing Australian jet lag strategies
headlines.description: The San Francisco 49ers easily dispatched the “withered” — and perhaps jet-lagged — Los Angeles Rams, 27-7, scoring a decisive victory for hyper-punctual business travelers around the globe.

headlines.title: Prosecutor who led ‘grand conspiracy’ probe of Trump targets resigns without charging anyone
headlines.description: Joe diGenova, 81, was part of a group that tried to overturn the 2020 election.

headlines.title: Halloween Chocolatey Eyeballs Candy Recalled Over Allergy Risks
headlines.description: New Jersey candy company Little Temptations has recalled their popular “chocolatey eyeballs” because of undeclared milk allergens. The candy is sold at major retailers including Marshalls, TJ Maxx, and Home Goods in 13 states.

headlines.title: Now recruiting: North Korea looks abroad for talent in its scheme to infiltrate U.S. companies
headlines.description: North Korea’s surreptitious push to plant employees in U.S. companies has expanded to include remote workers from other countries, such as Iran and Lebanon, according to U.S. government and foreign agencies and several cybersecurity researchers.
